outcome: operative delivery for presumed fetal compromise
cohort: 412 singleton pregnancies with an antenatal diagnosis of small-for-gestational-age (SGA) fetus, defined as estimated fetal weight below the 10th centile for gestational age at 36 weeks or beyond.
finding: The IRIS prediction model, incorporating maternal and intrapartum factors, demonstrated moderate accuracy in predicting operative delivery for presumed fetal compromise in term SGA fetuses.
birth_weight: Below the 10th percentile for gestational age
